quarterly_data.quarter: Ardentec IR presentation: 2026 Q2 investor conference (07-24-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Silicon photonics: the Ardentec group offers optoelectronic testing and advanced heterogeneous-integration packaging for the CPO ecosystem and partners with Fabrinet (and a group company) for one-stop CPO integration. CPO test capacity: EIC / PIC >150 tools; MicroLED >50 tools (being built). The group's new Hukou plant (>3,500 ping) starts mass production of new silicon-photonics products in Q3. The group's packaging affiliate launched a 12-inch silicon-photonics wafer-level packaging line in 2024, brought in several new customers in 2025 (30+ NPI products) and has >10 new customers in introduction / design in 2026.
quarterly_data.figure: CPO EIC / PIC test capacity >150 tools; Hukou silicon-photonics mass production Q3 2026
